As March approaches its end, this announcement will provide a comprehensive review and summary of the development outlook released in early March.
Some of the content has already been implemented on the season server, while the rest are due to considerations of season stability and data upgrade security. We will implement it in the fourth season early test server PTR4, which is expected to recruit testing officers for the Ghost Pioneer Camp as early as April.
In the future season, we will also adhere to the principle of not making significant updates in terms of content.
